title.provenance: Act concerning safety. Be it enacted by the People of the State of Illinois, represented in the General Assembly: Section 1. This Act may be referred to as the PFAS Consumer Protection Law.

status.provenance: Be it enacted by the People of the State of Illinois, represented in the General Assembly:

pfas_definition.provenance: No explicit PFAS definition provided in the document

type.provenance: On and after specified dates, no person shall sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in the State specified products that contain intentionally added PFAS chemicals.

exceptions: Cookware that contains an intentionally added PFAS chemical in the handle of the product or in any surface of the cookware that comes into contact with food, foodstuffs, or beverages and meets specific requirements
